big_case.notes: A two-party Mississippi divorce-decree contempt dispute over a roughly $21,000 property-damages award: a suspended six-month sentence with purge conditions, no incarceration, an intermediate state appellate court below, a summary state-high-court denial of review (two Justices voting to grant), no amicus, and a bare denial at the long conference with no relist, CVSG, or noted dissent. The Turner/Bearden question about civil-contempt incarceration for private money judgments has some national salience, but this record would not have let the Court reach it, and nothing in the outcome suggests any Justice engaged. Stakes confined to the parties.
